description: This file is a shell script used for testing globbing and noglob behavior in Git commands. It sets up various test cases to verify how Git handles path specifications with globbing patterns, literal paths, and related configurations.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with given parameters.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the timestamp for testing purposes.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected and actual output files.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Verifies that the output is empty.
